title: ServiceNow Now Platform - AI-native workflow automation across IT, HR, and customer service
clean_text: ServiceNow's Now Platform began as IT Service Management (ITSM) software and has expanded into a broader workflow automation platform spanning IT Operations Management, HR Service Delivery, and Customer Service Management, with built-in governance and risk controls. ServiceNow ITSM connects incident, problem, change, and request management on a single AI-driven platform to automate routine IT work. The platform targets large enterprises with complex, multi-department workflow needs; one cited example is a telecom company that expanded from a single ITSM deployment in 2013 to 10 ServiceNow products and over $10M in annual spend.

meta.target: large enterprises, multi-department IT/HR/customer service workflows
